answers.q1: It is a TableFormat with lineabove, linebelowheader, linebetweenrows and linebelow all None, headerrow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "^"), datarow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "|"), padding=0, with_header_hide=None.
answers.q2: The `tabulate()` docstring format list (plus a new doctest), the cli.py help text, the README format list, a new README section, and the README CLI help list.
answers.q3: It replaces "|" with "%%|%%" and "^" with "%%^%%" in each cell value, wrapping the literal separators in DokuWiki nowiki markers.
answers.q4: Decimal is treated like right alignment: "  " + value.rstrip() + " ". None/unknown alignment falls to the default branch: " " + value.strip() + " ".
answers.q5: Because the row callback receives cells already padded to column width, so the agent re-trims the padding on the aligned side so short cells don't look centered and the DokuWiki spacing conventions apply.
answers.q6: Per the material, it checks that an empty table gives "" and a header-only row; the exact expected strings are not shown.
answers.q7: test_dokuwiki_header_alignment failed (expected '^  name   ^...' but got '^   name   ^...'). The agent edited the test's expected string to match the actual output; the E12 patch also touched README.md and tabulate/__init__.py, but its content isn't shown.
answers.q8: The agent ran web searches for DokuWiki table syntax and opened DokuWiki's syntax.txt and handler.php from raw.githubusercontent.com. The material doesn't show which fetch failed, so unknown.
answers.q9: Ruff check (default config) exited 1 with 190 errors, including RUF022 and RUF100 on unchanged lines. The agent then reran with --config pyproject.toml, which also exited 1, and ruff format --check wanted to reflow a tabulate(...) call in test_dokuwiki_escape_separators.
answers.q10: It patched test/test_output.py to collapse that tabulate(...) call onto one line, then ran ruff check with a hand-picked --select E4,E7,E9,F,W,B,C4,ISC,I,C90,UP --ignore ... list plus ruff format --check, both of which passed.

q1.why: Matches all key facts: None lines, partial rows, padding=0, with_header_hide=None.

q2.why: Covers docstring, cli.py and README, but doesn't mention the doctest explicitly as in key and no note on tabulate_formats; mostly correct with README sections. Contains key places, though partial detail.

q3.why: Correct escaping, but doesn't state it applies to both header and data cells (says 'each cell value').

q4.why: Decimal like right with two leading spaces and rstrip; default stripped with single spaces.

q5.why: Cells pre-padded, re-trim so short cells don't look centered.

q6.why: Does not give the actual assertions; says strings not shown.

q7.why: Correct test name and fix to the test's expected string; README/docstring touched but vague. Doesn't give the actual expected strings fully but acceptable partial.

q8.why: Mentions search and syntax.txt but says unknown on which failed; misses the 404 on handler.php.

q9.why: Describes a different lint step; misses snap wrapper failure (exit 46) and switch to /snap/ruff/1713/bin/ruff.
